FAZ 7 (Ejderhalar) için kullan — run 53'te ilk spawn+uçuş AI'ı için kullanıldı (gameplay/dragons.js, DECISIONS.md ADR-0071). animationClips run 53'te gerçek headless-Chromium render ile düzeltildi: eski liste ("Run cycle"/"Walk cycle"/"Idle"/"Jump"/"Open Wings"/"Fly") dosyanın gerçek klip adlarıyla eşleşmiyordu — gerçek dosyada sadece 4 klip var, "Jump"/"Open Wings" hiç yok. Ayrıca kaynak FBX'in gömülü doku referansları (Dragon_ground_color.jpg vb.) `textures/` alt klasöründe, FBXLoader'ın varsayılan çözümleme dizini (FBX'in kendi dizini) değil — AssetLoader.loadFBXModel'e yeni `resourcePath` seçeneği eklendi (run 53) bu yüzden. Manually downloaded by project owner (bu sitenin indirme akışı otomatik tıklamayla tetiklenmiyor).

assets.notes: ⚠️ MISLABELED (found run 52, confirmed by real headless-Chromium render through the project's own AssetLoader/GLTFLoader — not assumed from the filename): despite the `dragon_reference_v1` id/filename, this file's actual geometry is a fully-textured fantasy castle/gatehouse (keep, twin corner towers, conical roofs, a banner, a wooden drawbridge) — NOT a dragon, and NOT the same asset as dragon_reference_v2/v3 (those two really are the same ornate gold dragon as each other, confirmed by render — see their own notes). Likely a batch-download/organizing mixup during the original manual asset step, not a code bug. Do not use this file for any FAZ 7 dragon work. Its castle content may still be useful for FAZ 3 (it already has baked material/texture, unlike the 7 geometry-only `castle_*` entries below), but that is a separate, not-yet-made product decision — left as-is, unconsumed by code, until a human or a future run deliberately decides to use it as a castle asset under a correctly-labeled id. Still needs its own decimation (~2M triangles, two 4096x4096 PNGs) before any real use either way.

assets.sourceUrl: https://hitem3d.ai
assets.notes: CONFIRMED (run 52, real headless-Chromium render): a real, fully-textured ornate gold/bronze dragon — the correct FAZ 7 reference model (dragon_reference_v1's id/filename is misleading, see its own note; v1 is actually an unrelated castle). Same tech debt as before (needs decimation/compression before use) — now resolved: see `dragon_reference_v2_decimated` below, produced this run and verified to render correctly at 19,762 triangles / 1.67MB, well inside the <20K tri / <5MB target. Kept at full size here for provenance/re-decimation if a different ratio is ever needed; the decimated file is the one any future FAZ 7 code should actually load.

assets.source: Derived from dragon_reference_v2 (Hitem3d) via gltf-transform 4.4.2 CLI — weld, simplify (ratio 0.0099, error 0.06), resize (textures to 512x512), prune. Produced and verified run 52 (DECISIONS.md ADR-0070).

assets.notes: Production-ready decimated dragon reference model — the file any future FAZ 7 spawn/AI code should actually load, not the ~2M-triangle originals. Verified via a real headless-Chromium render through the project's own AssetLoader.loadModel (not the placeholder-box fallback), zero console/page errors, silhouette/texture still clearly reads as the same dragon after a ~99% triangle reduction and ~98% file-size reduction. Not rigged/animated — FAZ 7 will still need to add a skeleton or procedural wing-flap/flight animation separately, same gap `dragon_verdant_wyrm`'s notes already flag for its own model.

assets.sourceUrl: https://hitem3d.ai
assets.notes: CONFIRMED (run 52, real render): the same ornate gold dragon as dragon_reference_v2 (not v1 — v1 is an unrelated castle, see its own note), a third generation attempt from the same reference image. dragon_reference_v2 was picked as the one to decimate (arbitrary tie-break between two near-identical successful generations, v2 tried first); this file is now superseded by dragon_reference_v2_decimated and not needed further. Kept for provenance rather than deleted this run — a future cleanup pass may delete v1/v3's full-size originals once FAZ 7 actually ships and nobody has needed to re-decimate at a different ratio.
